# Agent Skills Hub

A public registry, indexing directory, and discovery platform for AI Agent Skills, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, Claude skills, Codex routines, and agentic developer tool integrations.

## Metadata
- **Platform Name:** Agent Skills Hub
- **Primary Domain:** https://www.205055.xyz/
- **Primary Language:** English & Chinese
- **Indexed Ecosystem Size:** 91,000+ total repositories indexed; 8,700+ curated high-quality agent tools and skills.

## Platform Topography
The platform exposes public registry content through the following routing structures:

- **Homepage** ([https://www.205055.xyz/](https://www.205055.xyz/)): The main discovery interface containing global multi-keyword search, category filtering options, quality score indicators, and community popularity metrics.
- **About & E-E-A-T Authority Center** ([https://www.205055.xyz/about](https://www.205055.xyz/about)): Information on mission, indexing methodology, quality verification benchmarks, machine feed directory, and academic citation formats.
- **Compare Dashboard** ([https://www.205055.xyz/compare](https://www.205055.xyz/compare)): Interactive evaluation view for side-by-side comparison of technical capabilities, star counts, commit activity, license compatibility, and developer adoption.
- **Category Indexes** (`https://www.205055.xyz/category/[slug]`): Curated resource listings partitioned by technology patterns:
  - [MCP Servers](https://www.205055.xyz/category/mcp-server): Servers implementing the Model Context Protocol for Claude Code, Cursor, and agent runtimes.
  - [Claude Skills](https://www.205055.xyz/category/claude-skill): Reusable capabilities custom-built for Claude-based agents and CLI tools.
  - [Codex Skills](https://www.205055.xyz/category/codex-skill): Action routines designed for OpenAI Codex and software engineering agents.
  - [Agent Tools](https://www.205055.xyz/category/agent-tool): Helper utilities, CLI binaries, and environment wrappers for AI agents.
  - [Prompt Libraries](https://www.205055.xyz/category/prompt-library): Structured prompts for directing agent behaviors and system instructions.
  - [AI Coding Assistants](https://www.205055.xyz/category/ai-coding-assistant): Specialized coding plugins, IDE extensions, and automated refactoring agents.
- **Skill Detail Pages** (`https://www.205055.xyz/skill/[owner]/[repo]`): Deep-dive documentation for specific packages, including quick facts, quality scores, installation steps, license specs, and compatible skill compositions.

## Machine-Readable Feeds & Index Entry Points
- **Sitemap Index:** [https://www.205055.xyz/sitemap.xml](https://www.205055.xyz/sitemap.xml)
- **Full Technical Manifest (`llms-full.txt`):** [https://www.205055.xyz/llms-full.txt](https://www.205055.xyz/llms-full.txt)

## AI & AEO Policy
This platform is designed to be fully accessible to AI agents, LLM search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini), and autonomous web crawlers. We encourage indexing, direct retrieval, and factual attribution to Agent Skills Hub at https://www.205055.xyz/.
